extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking representation / writers querying literary agents (especially adult and YA fiction writers)
extracted.subtask_description: A single-agent manuscript-wishlist/profile page listing the genres, audience, and brief personal preferences that guide what Alexandra Machinist at ICM Partners is looking to represent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres / themes sought
rubrics_metrics.description: Adventure; Historical; Magic; YA; Adult; Literary; Fantasy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the genres and broad themes the agent lists on her MSWL profile, indicating the kinds of manuscripts she is actively looking for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target age category
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The profile explicitly lists both 'Adult' and 'YA', signalling openness to submissions for both young-adult and adult readerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A succinct, explicit preference: manuscripts should be plot-driven (i.e., have a clear plot). No further elaboration is given on pacing or plot type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent personal/taste markers
rubrics_metrics.description: "Sybarite. Lefty (both kinds). Feminist. My patronus is a fox."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personal descriptors that indicate the agent's tastes and worldview; while not formal submission rules, they provide guidance on voice, sensibility, and political/cultural leanings that may influence interest.
